title: Bug Fix
summary: We fixed a bug that caused Claude to use your ANTHROPICAPIKEY if one was set in your environment, even if you were on a Pro/Max/Team account.
html: We fixed a bug that caused Claude to use your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if one was set in your environment, even if you were on a Pro/Max/Team account.
markdown: We fixed a bug that caused Claude to use your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if one was set in your environment, even if you were on a Pro/Max/Team account.
